title: Local Consumer Review Survey 2026: Star Ratings Keep Rising, Old Reviews Don’t Cut It

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey reports that 97% of consumers read reviews for local businesses.
facts.quote: 97% of consumers read reviews for local businesses

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 survey reports that 41% of consumers 'always' read reviews when browsing for businesses, up from 29% the prior year.
facts.quote: In 2026, 41% of consumers “always” read reviews when browsing for businesses, a huge jump from last year (29%).

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 survey reports that the average consumer uses six different review sites when choosing businesses.
facts.quote: The average consumer uses six different review sites when choosing businesses

facts.fact: BrightLocal's survey reports that Google's share of consumer review use dipped from 83% in 2025 to 71% in 2026.
facts.quote: this year its share has dipped from 83% in 2025 to 71%

facts.fact: BrightLocal's own recent research found that 35% of SMBs have a Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: 35% of SMBs have a Google Business Profile

facts.fact: BrightLocal's CEO states that 97% of consumers still lean on reviews to guide their purchase decisions, per the 2026 survey.
facts.quote: 97% of consumers still lean on reviews to guide their purchase decisions

facts.fact: The Local Consumer Review Survey is an annual BrightLocal study that tracks consumer behavior around online reviews.
facts.quote: Each year, the Local Consumer Review Survey tracks the behavior of consumers around reviews

facts.fact: The BrightLocal 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey article was published on February 11, 2026.
